<div class="card-body">
'''Death Squadron''' is a [[Dark]] [[Effect]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)|Hoth (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">＊デス・スコードロン</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">任意の星系上に配備する。その星系にいる自分の宇宙船の合計戦闘力にＸを加える。Ｘ＝その場所にいる自分の宇宙船の数である。自分の兵員／トルーパーと戦闘用ビークルは、同じ星系の位置カードに対して、フォースを消費せずにシャトルできる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Hoth-Death-Squadron-PSA-151452822.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">「兵員をエネルギー・シールドの外側に降下させろ。艦隊を展開して、一隻たりとも星系外へ逃がすな」</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Death Squadron.

'''Card text:'''
Deploy on any system. Adds X to the total power of your starships at that system, where X = the number of your starships present. Your troopers and combat vehicles may shuttle to sites of the same system without spending Force.

'''Lore:'''
"Land the troops beyond the energy shield. Deploy the fleet, and let not one ship escape the system."

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese shuttles to sites of the same system; the English to related sites.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Death Squadron]] in [[Hoth (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 43, 103. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
